//: Turbo runs tasks in a strict (filtered) environment. The DB-backed test suites and the web build read runtime config from process.env (packages/db/src/env.ts, apps/api/src/env.ts, next build), so those vars must be passed through — otherwise `turbo run test/build` sees an empty env and the db/api tests fail with 'DATABASE_URL Required' even though CI set it at the job level. These are non-secret runtime/config vars, so passThrough (not part of the cache hash) is correct.
